question: How much capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retain after its 1000 cycles?
rendered:
According to the text, after 4 formation cycles, the pouch cell was charged/discharged at 1 C/2 C rates for 1000 cycles and the capacity degraded to 65.7% of its initial capacity. 

So, the 1.4 Ah pouch cell retained 65.7% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles.
